title: Ztn
wikitext:
American player and mapper most famous for his "ZTN Series", [[ztndm3]] being one of the six. [[ztn]] has created numerous maps for all of the Quake series up to Quake3, mainly for [[1on1]], [[2on2]] or [[FFA]].
